decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are closely related to the firm's core heat-exchange know-how, and with strong in-house R&D, EU research participation, and a broad installed-service base, management is likely to retain and improve rather than withdraw this product.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on the firm's established technical capabilities and benefit from its absorptive capacity, so management would see good scope to learn, refine, and commercialize them further instead of dropping them.
